name: twiniti-loop
description: Cursor plugin wrapping Twiniti Loop MCP: contacts, segments, and campaign drafts over Streamable HTTP. Does not rebuild the MCP server.

LOOP_MCP_URL.title: Loop MCP URL
LOOP_MCP_URL.description: Regional Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. EU default; use loop.us.twiniti.ai/mcp or loop.uk.twiniti.ai/mcp for those workspaces, or http://localhost:4000/mcp for local API.

LOOP_AGENT_TOKEN.title: Loop agent token (secret)
LOOP_AGENT_TOKEN.description: Secret. Bearer token from the Loop workspace Agents page (shown once). Prefix twiniti_agent_. Never commit, paste in chat, or put in tickets.
